name: Pan-Fried Moroccan Salmon with Apricot, Plum & Cucumber Couscous Salad

instructions.primary_message: In a medium saucepan, bring broth to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes; fluff with a fork.
instructions.secondary_message:
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ cups whole wheat couscous

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on a plate. Season with spices on the top-side.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg salmon fillet
1 ½ tsp paprika
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp coriander, ground
¾ tsp cumin, ground
3 pinch cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add salmon, skin-side down, and cook until skin is crispy and flesh is opaque, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside.
While the salmon is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 small pkg fresh basil
6 plums
1 ½ English cucumbers

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice lemons into a large bowl. Add tahini, honey, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp tahini
2 tbsp honey
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve plums lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Cut each half into ¼-inch thick slices. Add to the bowl.
Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop apricots. Add to the bowl and set aside.
When the couscous is done, transfer to a large baking sheet pan. Spread out in an even layer and let cool slightly, 5 minutes.
Add cooled couscous to the bowl with the salad and gently stir to combine.
To serve, divide couscous salad and salmon between plates. Enjoy!
